description: Select among candidates by sorting descending on <axis>; the top entry is chosen first. Axis names are vocabulary-bound (see axis rows).
engine_notes: Stable sort recommended; if ties matter define tie_break (below). O(n log n) per axis unless pool is tiny.

description: Select among candidates by sorting ascending on <axis>; the bottom entry is chosen first.
engine_notes: Same as greatest with inverted order; combine with n-th forms for fine targeting.

description: Select the nth candidate after sorting descending on <axis> (1 = top). Out-of-range n falls through to next rule or default random.
engine_notes: Validate n at preset compile time when possible; cap n to pool size at runtime to avoid exceptions.

description: Select the nth candidate after sorting ascending on <axis> (1 = lowest). Out-of-range falls through.
engine_notes: Same validation notes as n greatest.

script_api: next((e for e in pool if e.grid_row == 1), None)
description: Restrict or prioritize targets in the first row of the battle grid when row semantics exist.
engine_notes: No-op or same-as-all if layout has no rows; document grid contract per encounter.

script_api: next((e for e in pool if e.grid_row == 2), None)
description: Restrict or prioritize targets in the second row of the battle grid.

script_api: next((e for e in pool if e.grid_row == 3), None)
description: Restrict or prioritize targets in the third row of the battle grid.

script_api: next((e for e in pool if e.has_trait("<trait>")), None)
description: From current candidate pool pick a character that has <trait> (stunned buffed debuffed etc.).
engine_notes: Intersect with pool early to shrink work; traits should be O(1) flags on combat entities.

script_api: next((e for e in pool if e.archetype == "<archetype>"), None)
description: From current candidate pool pick a character matching <archetype> (ranger magician warrior buffer tank).
engine_notes: Prefer integer enum archetype IDs internally; string labels for authoring only.

script_api: next((e for e in pool if party_flag(e, "<flag>")), None)
description: Selector: any entity in the candidate pool that currently carries the party-visible mark <flag> (see assign_flag). Other allies can read the same mark without recomputing focus logic.
engine_notes: Index party_flags by flag id per tick if many queries; O(1) check on entity.

description: When choosing an action prefer skills tagged attack or DPS over heals or utility.
engine_notes: Resolve by skill priority table; if no attack skill available fall through to next rule or random legal skill.

description: When choosing an action prefer healing skills when any ally is healable under rules.
engine_notes: Short-circuit if no hurt ally: skip to next rule.

description: When choosing an action prefer buff-type skills on valid allies.
When choosing an action prefer debuff-type skills on valid enemies.
When choosing an action prefer CC or stun-tagged skills when legal.
Trait: entity currently under stun or equivalent CC (definition shared combat module).
engine_notes: Evaluated each tick; cache invalidates on state change only.

description: Trait: entity has at least one positive status from the buff category.
Trait: entity has at least one negative status from the debuff category.
Trait or archetype label for ranger (authoring); runtime maps to archetype enum.
Trait or archetype label for magician.
Trait or archetype label for warrior.
Trait or archetype label for buffer.
Trait or archetype label for tank.
Numeric comparator: left expression strictly greater than right.
engine_notes: Use same unit for both sides (HP absolute vs percent — pick one per preset).

description: Numeric comparator: left strictly less than right.
Numeric or enum comparator: equality within epsilon for floats if used.
Numeric or enum comparator: inequality.
Numeric comparator: left >= right.
Numeric comparator: left <= right.
Selector resolving to the executing character (self).
engine_notes: Always exactly one entity; no sort needed.

description: Comparison axis: constitution stat (or derived effective value).
engine_notes: Snapshot at evaluation time or start of phase — document which.

description: Comparison axis: dexterity stat.
Comparison axis: wisdom stat.
Comparison axis: maximum HP.
Comparison axis: current HP.
Comparison axis: speed or initiative stat.
Comparison axis: tier or level band used for targeting (encounter-defined).
Selector: the enemy or character last damaged by this character's attack.
engine_notes: Stale if target died or left; define fallback (null → fall through).

description: Selector: the attacker who last damaged this character.
engine_notes: Same stale rules as last hit.

script_api: next((e for e in pool if "<tag>" in e.tags), None)
description: From candidate pool choose any entity whose content tag set contains <tag> (authoring tags on skills/assets). Not the same as party character flags (marks); see character with flag.
engine_notes: Tags as interned strings or enum; pool filter O(n) unless indexed by tag per tick.

description: resolve_selector(<selector>
engine_notes: Party mark: attach named flag to the character(s) resolved by <selector> (e.g. focus_damage heal_priority cc_focus). Published to encounter-wide party state so every preset can target or react without recomputing who is call-out. Replaces prior holder if flag is single-slot (see engine_notes).
column7: Sync across allies: invalidate selector caches when flags change. Optional policy: one entity per flag name (focus) vs many (soft_mark).

description: Remove mark <flag> from all entities that currently hold it (encounter reset or tactic change).
engine_notes: Consider narrow variant clear_flag <flag> from <selector> for single-entity unmark.

description: entity=resolve_selector(<selector>
engine_notes: Remove mark <flag> only from the resolved entity.

script_api: (implicit: rules[] evaluated in order; first match)
description: Authoring contract: rules in a character preset are evaluated top to bottom; first fully applicable rule wins unless marked continue.
engine_notes: Optimization: short-circuit on first match; index rules by cheap guards first.

description: Fallback when no rule matches: pick uniformly among legal enemy targets (or allies for heals — mode-defined).
engine_notes: Documented default for play-without-presets random behavior.

description: Tie-break helper after sort ties.
engine_notes: Deterministic seed optional for replay/debug.

description: When ties remain break by row order then by axis secondary (authoring-defined).
engine_notes: Avoids RNG flapping between frames.

description: Begins a rule block that only runs on this character's initiative step (before actions resolve). Use to separate planning hooks from reactive triggers.
engine_notes: Evaluate once per turn entry; cheap guard. Combine with preset_rule_order so inner steps still short-circuit.

description: Begins a block when the named skill is off cooldown and affordable (MP/resources) and passes any skill-specific gates.
engine_notes: Check skill availability before expensive selectors; cache cooldown state per tick if many rules reference it.

description: Begins a block when this character's stat on <axis> compares to <value> using the given comparator (same vocabulary as row-level comparators).
engine_notes: Evaluate after stat snapshots for the tick; document whether buffs mid-turn re-evaluate (usually no until next decision).

description: Conditional guard: evaluate boolean expression using selectors axes and comparators; inner commands run only if true.
engine_notes: Short-circuit evaluation; avoid nested depth explosion — flatten to ordered rules when possible.

description: Local slot (this character only): store resolved entity in named <slot> for the rest of this decision chain (scratch buffer). Distinct from party flags which label characters for everyone.
engine_notes: Validate legality at bind-time and again at skill resolve if state changed; illegal bind → fall through or clear slot.

description: Copy the current pipeline target into local slot <slot> (same as set_target but uses implicit current_target). Examples for slot names: a b c d group_damage_focus (local alias not party flag unless you also assign_flag).
engine_notes: If you want the party to see focus use assign_flag to <selector> not only slots.

description: Clears local target slots for this character.
engine_notes: Rarely needed if each turn rebuilds slots.

description: Clears only the named local slot.
Encounter counter / script state (wave phase boss phase counters). Not a character tag; use assign_flag for who-to-focus coordination.
engine_notes: Persist only within combat instance unless saved to campaign; small enum ids.

description: Use skill on entity bound in local slot.
engine_notes: Resolve skill by stable id; if slot empty or stale fall through.

description: Use skill on whoever currently holds the party flag (e.g. heal the ally tagged heal_priority).
engine_notes: Skill must still be legal for that target (range LOS resources).

description: Orders this character to move to front row 1 middle row 2 or back row 3 when the battle grid uses row positions.
engine_notes: If movement consumes turn resolve order vs skill use; reject invalid lines or clamp per encounter config.

script_api: axis(entity, "current_health")  # example; name from axis rows
description: Built-in helper: returns the stat value for the named axis on an entity. Prefer in embedded scripts so names stay aligned with the DSL.
engine_notes: Expose readonly snapshots in sandbox; inject pool enemies allies self slots party_flags global_flags.

script_api: focus_damage heal_priority cc_focus debuff_focus tank_peel group_damage_focus individual_damage_focus
description: Illustrative party flag ids for assign_flag / character with flag; define allowed set per content pack.
engine_notes: Same mental model as your a;b;c;d focus roles — now explicit tags on entities everyone reads.

description: Party flags are shared marks on characters: once assigned everyone’s AI can aim heals buffs and focus fire at the same entity without recomputing. Local slots are only this preset’s scratch variables. Content tags (select any with tag) label skills/assets. global_flag is numeric encounter state not character labels.
engine_notes: Store party_flags as flag_name -> entity_id(s); replicate or broadcast on assign/clear; invalidate targeting caches when flags change.
